taxonomic_note: Accepted by current Kew/POWO and native to Texas at state scale.
look_here_first: Look for hairiness before the airy panicle: conspicuously hirsute leaf sheaths plus distinctly bearded panicle branch axils are the strongest combination.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Uvalde is the only exact project target-zone county currently locked. Statewide Texas nativity and the old Hays-local flag are not county proof.

approval_exception.reason: Learner inclusion is independent from native-range certification.

best_field_traits: ciliate sheath mouth and hairy ligule
morphology_keys.comparison_training: E. intermedia is much more glabrous on the sheaths; E. trichodes concentrates hairs near the sheath apex rather than across the sheath surface.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Shaggy sheath surface plus bearded panicle nodes strongly favor E. hirsuta.
